answers.core: This is a proposed enhancement for a core feature that already exists.
answers.workaround:
One can work around the limited number of available ID bits, using a layer of abstraction.
For example we can work with UIDs as metadata of the listed items using `set|get_item_metadata` methods where available; but it is not that ergonomic compared to `add_item(label: String, id: int = -1)`, specially because you need to know the index of the item first.

title: Allow PopupMenu and OptionButton to support 64-bit ID values
